Fositek.why: Supplies liquid-cooling UQDs / cold plates and high-load slide rails into the GB200/GB300 rack supply chain; AI-server components are one of its two growth engines.
Fositek.evidence: Fositek AGM handbook: 2025 Business Report (05-26-2026): 'Fositek has passed water cooling supply certification and entered the GB200/GB300 supply chain ... this vertically integrated "Cold Plate + UQD" solution has successfully entered the supply chains of the four major North American CSPs.'

players.product: liquid-cooling Universal Quick Disconnects (UQD) and cold plates, plus high-load server slide rails, for GB200/GB300 AI server racks

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 Business Report: consolidated net operating revenue for 2025 was approximately NT$12.41 billion, up 51.6% from NT$8.18 billion in 2024, mainly driven by mass production and shipment of foldable phone hinges, server product components and laptop hinges; operating revenue NT$12,413,930 thousand, gross profit NT$3,270,371 thousand, net profit after tax NT$2,125,300 thousand (2024: NT$1,227,364 thousand), basic EPS NT$31.00 (2024: NT$17.90). Management: record highs in revenue and profit in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue ~NT$12.41 billion (+51.6%); net profit NT$2,125,300 thousand; EPS NT$31.00

quarterly_data.signal: Management (2025 Business Report): Fositek has passed water cooling supply certification and entered the GB200/GB300 supply chain; beyond components it provides complete cold-plate solutions, and its vertically integrated 'Cold Plate + UQD' solution has entered the supply chains of the four major North American CSPs (not named). Management describes the Universal Quick Disconnect (UQD) as one of the most technically demanding liquid-cooling components (leakage rate as low as one drop per ten thousand).

Management: as AI server rack weight rises sharply, Fositek uses its self-developed slide-rail roll-forming process to make high-load RVL slide rails with patent-avoidance designs, 'gradually capturing market share in the high-end segment'; its 'Slide Rail + Water Cooling Connector' integrated module strategy simplifies customer procurement. Strategy: interface with top global CSPs, increase the direct supply ratio and enhance the profitability of server mechanical components.

Outlook (2025 Business Report): management describes a 'Dual-Engine' growth model - a rising share of AI server-related revenue plus the foldable-phone replacement wave it expects from Apple's expected entry into the foldable phone market; for 2026 the company will continue developing strategic customers and gave no public financial forecast.
